title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 4:12-17
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 4:12-17</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Rise of the Messiah (2024)
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="12" /> Now, when he heard that <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="violet">Ioannes</char> had been handed over,
      </group>
      <group>
        he departed into <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">Galilaia</char>,
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="13" /> and having left Nazara,
      </group>
      <group>
        coming he dwelt in Kapharnaoum <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">beside the sea</char>,
      </group>
      <group>
        in the regions of <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">Zaboulon and Nephthalim</char>,
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="14" /> so that <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">what was spoken through Esaias the prophet would be fulfilled</char>, saying,
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="15" /> “Land of <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">Zaboulon</char> and land of <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">Nephthalim</char>,
      </group>
      <group>
        path of <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">the sea</char>, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">beyond the Iordanes</char>,
      </group>
      <group>
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">Galilaia</char> of the nations,
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="16" /> the people <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="black">sitting in darkness</char>,
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">a great light</char> they have seen,
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        and to those sitting in a country and shadow of <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="black">death</char>,
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">a light has east-arisen</char> on them.”
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="17" /> From then on, Iesous began to announce and say,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        “Change-direction!
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        Because <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="violet">the kingdom of</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">the skies</char> has come near!”
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
